logRetentionHelp: Application log files, excluding Docker logs. Rules apply to file families, including numbered or dated names. The active file is always retained.
logApplicationDescription: Server requests, errors, warnings and application operations. Names such as app.1.log and app.2.log are rotations of the same source.
logCodexDescription: Technical JSON-RPC exchanges with the agent engine: requests, responses and notifications. This diagnostic log is not conversation history. Retention enables rotation of new writes at the selected size.
logRetentionTable: Retention and storage by log type
logNoFiles: No files for this log type.
logRetentionTableHelp: Sizes include active files and archives, regardless of browsing filters. Age and count limits apply only when retention is enabled. Use the ⋮ menu to configure each log type.
logCodexRotationHelp: The threshold applies to new writes at JSON-RPC entry boundaries. An already large file is archived intact on the next write; it is not retroactively split or compressed. An individual entry may exceed the threshold.
logOversizedArchiveHelp: An archive exceeds the current rotation threshold. This threshold does not shrink existing archives and is not a total storage limit. The archive will be automatically deleted when it exceeds the maximum age or retained archive count, if retention remains enabled.
logOtherDescription: Other files: contents not automatically identified, with no automatic deletion.
logApplicationRotation: The application opens a new file approximately every 10 MiB.
logRetentionDeletionWarning: After saving, archives exceeding the age OR count limit will be permanently deleted at the next automatic pass (about one minute). Unknown files, symbolic links and conversation history are never deleted.
logRetentionSaveFailed: Could not save the retention policy.
logStorageEstimateHelp: Total log file size on the server, including technical logs not displayed here, regardless of filters. Refreshed every 30 seconds.
